text:
sam: noticed a surge of fncall schema errors on /invoke/tool in ap-south-1 after SDK 2.5 shipped. reject_rate ~4% vs baseline 0.3%. Looks like models returning top-level arrays.

anya: did validator v3.4 change union handling?

sam: yes strict mode enabled by default for new routes. payloads with array responses are failing.

diego: quick mitigations: header-based soft-validate for sdk=2.5, 1% sampled payload capture (redact PII), and add metric label `validation_mode` to split charts.

kevin: watch quota attribution. Add transient token cap per-tenant (+5%) while permissive is active; auto-revert if exceeded.

ops-bot: change applied: soft-validate for sdk=2.5 in ap-south-1 at 2026-03-23T18:40:10Z (cfg-9234). sampling=1% tag=fncall-soft-sample.

sam: monitoring adapter.error_rate and token_spend. console: please expose validation_mode split and a permissive-mode badge.

anya: will file UI task and add strictness history in route config. diego: can you add validator_version label too?

diego: done. will also add `coercion_attempts` counter to assess auto-fixes.

sam: plan: keep permissive for 20m, collect samples, patch validator to accept arrays if safe, then flip back.
